topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture, links it to recent histopathology practicals, and outlines the day's learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor virology, oncogene discovery, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the historical investigation of transforming retroviruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and led to laboratory assays for cell transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressors, and cell cycle control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics classify cancer-associated gene mutations and illustrate how they disrupt growth control through pathways including Rb and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the distinctions, DNA repair failures, and mitotic segregation defects that generate sequence instability and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep progression and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential gene mutations drive tumor development across sporadic cases and inherited cancer syndromes.

topics.label: Closing remarks and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session with book recommendations and a preview of the next lecture.
